# m.forex.quotes

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Foreign exchange quotes: the best bid and ask of each currency pair, tick by tick.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.forex.quotes(symbols)
```

- Query methods: `blink()`, `append_only()`, `ring()`, `last_by()`, `history()`
- Read from: REST, flat files, WebSocket

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Currency pairs as Massive's tickers, such as `C:EURUSD` (`dm.canonical_symbol_forex` converts `EUR/USD`), or `dm.ALL`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Quotes (flat files) | Quotes (REST) | Quotes (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included | Not included | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | End-of-day, All history | Real-time, All history | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | End-of-day, All history | Real-time, All history | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description | Read from |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST: the request's `fxTicker` parameter; flat files `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under."; WebSocket `p`: "The current pair." | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the UTC date of `Timestamp`. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. From REST `participant_timestamp`: "The nanosecond Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the quote was generated at the exchange."; flat files `participant_timestamp`: "The nanosecond accuracy Participant/Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the quote was actually generated at the exchange."; WebSocket `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `BidPrice` | double | The bid price. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `AskPrice` | double | The ask price. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `BidExchange` | long | The bid exchange ID | REST, flat files |
| `AskExchange` | long | The ask exchange ID | REST, flat files |
| `Exchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | WebSocket |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
